patterns.match:
(?xi)
([a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+ (?: \s*\|\s* [a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+)*) # union or single exception class
\s*
((\$+)[a-z_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}][a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}]*)?           # Variable

(?xi)
((?:(?:(?:public|private|protected)(?:\(set\))?|static|readonly)(?:\s+|(?=\?)))++)                     # At least one modifier
(
  # nullable type
  (?:\?\s*)? [a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+ |
  # union, intersection or DNF type
  (?: [a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+ | \(\s* [a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+(?:\s*&\s*[a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+)+ \s*\) )
  (?: \s*[|&]\s*
  (?: [a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+ | \(\s* [a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+(?:\s*&\s*[a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+)+ \s*\) )
  )+
)?
\s+ ((\$)[a-z_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}][a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}]*)          # Variable name

(?xi)
(?: (
  # nullable type
  (?:\?\s*)? [a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+ |
  # union, intersection or DNF type
  (?: [a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+ | \(\s* [a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+(?:\s*&\s*[a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}\\]+)+ \s*\) )
  (?: \s*[|&]\s*

  )+
) \s+ )?
((?:(&)\s*)?(\.\.\.)(\$)[a-z_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}][a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}]*) # Variable name with possible reference
(?=\s*(?:,|\)|/[/*]|\#|$)) # A closing parentheses (end of argument list) or a comma or a comment

patterns.begin:

(
  \\?(?<![a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}])                            # Optional root namespace
  [a-z_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}][a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}]*          # First namespace

patterns.end:
(?ix)
(?:\s+
  (?:
    # variadic parameter
    (
      (?:(&)\s*)?          # reference operator
      (\.\.\.)           # variadic operator
      (\$)                 # variable sigil
      [a-z_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}][a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}]*
    )|
    # non-variadic parameter
    (
      (?:(&)\s*)?          # reference operator
      (\$)                 # variable sigil
      [a-z_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}][a-z0-9_\x{7f}-\x{10ffff}]*
    )
  )
)?
(?=\s|\*/)

regexp-double-quoted.begin:
(?x)
(")  # PHP string opener
(/)  # regex delimiter
(?=
  (?:  # regex body that can appear before the closing /flags"
    # Raw Q...E literal blocks inside the regex source.
    \\Q (?: \\. | (?! \\E | /[imsxeADSUXu]*" | " ). )* (?: \\E )?
    # The same construct after PHP decoding has already produced \Q.
    | \\\\Q (?: \\. | (?! \\\\E | /[imsxeADSUXu]*" | " ). )* (?: \\\\E )?
    # Ordinary regex escapes that keep the body from terminating early.
    | \\ (?: \\(?: \\[\\"]? | [^"] ) | . )
    # Character classes are treated as opaque top-level atoms here. Their
    # broken-host recovery belongs to the class rules themselves.
    | \[
        (?: \^? \] )?
        (?: \\. | . )*?
      \]
    # Any other raw regex atom that cannot start the wrapper terminator.
    | (?! ["/\\\[] ).
  )++
  /[imsxeADSUXu]*"
)
regexp-double-quoted.name: meta.embedded.regexp.php
